sources.title: Testing the Swampland: $H_0$ tension

evidence.text: Does increasing the constant potential slope in canonical exponential quintessence improve agreement between cosmologically fitted H0 and the higher local Riess determination? The comparison tests an observational consequence of a proposed Swampland-compatible dark-energy family.

sources.title: Beta function quintessence cosmological parameters and fundamental constants – II. Exponential and logarithmic dark energy potentials

evidence.text: How do logarithmic and exponential quintessence evolve between redshifts nine and zero, and which observables distinguish these models from a fiducial flat ΛCDM cosmology?

sources.title: Is curvature-assisted quintessence observationally viable?

evidence.text: Can negative spatial curvature make steep, single-field exponential quintessence compatible with cosmological observations and the strong de Sitter conjecture? Inflation is considered through a secondary qualitative argument.

sources.title: News from the Swampland — constraining string theory with astrophysics and cosmology

evidence.text: How strongly do late-time cosmological observations constrain Swampland-compatible single-field quintessence, how do electromagnetic couplings change the problem, and how assumption-dependent are expansion-history reconstructions?

sources.title: Dark Energy in the Swampland

evidence.text: How tightly do then-current observations and prospective dark-energy surveys constrain quintessence satisfying the string Swampland criteria, and could observations distinguish surviving models from a cosmological constant?

sources.title: Quintessence and false vacuum: Two sides of the same coin?

evidence.text: Can a quintessence field initially trapped in a metastable false vacuum evolve into a stable late-time dark-energy configuration through vacuum decay, while satisfying imposed swampland constraints?

sources.title: Has DESI detected exponential quintessence?

evidence.text: Does the paper's DESI DR2 data combination favor minimally coupled exponential quintessence over ΛCDM, with or without spatial curvature, and does the apparent CPL phantom crossing exclude this physical non-phantom model?

sources.title: Theoretical Limits on Agegraphic Quintessence from Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What bound on the agegraphic parameter n follows from an assumed sub-Planckian quintessence excursion criterion, does it agree with the observational interval quoted in 2010, and can multiple scalar fields remove any tension?

sources.title: Breaking Free from the Swampland of Impossible Universes Through the DESI Portal

evidence.text: Which string-inspired quintessence and interacting dark-sector scenarios can accommodate the reported DESI preference for evolving dark energy while satisfying proposed quantum-gravity constraints?

sources.title: The String Theory Swampland in the Euclid, Square Kilometer Array, and Vera Rubin Observatory Era

evidence.text: Can future measurements of late-time acceleration force canonical quintessence potentials to be too flat for the de Sitter conjecture? The proposed test depends on a conjectural restriction on string-theory effective descriptions and the assumed dark-energy realization.

sources.title: Assessing observational constraints on dark energy

evidence.text: How should canonical quintessence models be represented on a CPL w0–wa plane when observations constrain expansion histories, and does preference for w0>−1 with w0+wa<−1 require actual NEC violation?

sources.title: Background Instability of Quintessence Model in Light of Entropy and Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can entropy-bound and distance-conjecture reasoning determine instability and lifetime of exponential quintessence, and connect these with trans-Planckian censorship and KK/Hubble scale separation?

sources.title: Stability, dark energy parameterization and swampland aspect of Bianchi type-$V I_h$ cosmological models with $f(R,T)$-gravity

evidence.text: Can anisotropic Bianchi VI_h cosmology in f(R,T) gravity, with an imposed time-dependent deceleration parameter, describe an acceleration transition, pass physical-acceptability diagnostics, and support a quintessence correspondence satisfying swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Implications of single field inflation in general cosmological scenarios on the nature of dark energy given the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Could percent-level constraints on the dark-energy equation of state distinguish a modified-cosmology quintessence model from w=-1? The paper names several surveys and instruments as motivation for exploring that possibility.

sources.title: Possible Theoretical limits on holographic quintessence from weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can a conjectured sub-Planckian excursion limit restrict the parameters of holographic dark energy when its background evolution is represented by a canonical quintessence scalar?

sources.title: Cosmological constraints on curved quintessence

evidence.text: How do Planck CMB, DESI BAO and alternative supernova catalogues constrain single-field exponential quintessence when spatial curvature is free, and how does its fit compare with ΛCDM and CPL dark energy?

sources.title: Cosmic concordance and quintessence

evidence.text: Which spatially flat matter-plus-quintessence models satisfy the paper's historical cosmological observations, how do conservative concordance bounds differ from Gaussian likelihood bounds, and which observations could distinguish quintessence from Λ?

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: How do the calculational control and phenomenological difficulties of string de Sitter constructions compare with quintessence, particularly under the proposed de Sitter swampland criterion, Higgs couplings, and fifth-force constraints?

sources.title: Phantom matters

evidence.text: Can coupling canonical quintessence to matter, and possibly radiation, produce an effective phantom dark-energy regime while accommodating steep string-inspired potentials? What determine effective equation-of-state poles and the early dark-energy-like feature in these solutions?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture and Holographic Dark Energy model with Interaction and Spatial Curvature

evidence.text: Can spatial curvature and phenomenological matter–dark-energy interactions allow holographic quintessence to satisfy the adopted sub-Planckian scalar-excursion criterion within the observational parameter regions used by the paper?

sources.title: Dark Energy in the Swampland II

evidence.text: Can observational upper limits on the slope of exponential quintessence become smaller than a theoretically established Swampland lower limit, thereby excluding this dark-energy class under both requirements?

sources.title: Constraining spatial curvature with priors from swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Do swampland-motivated slope priors, excluding the curved ΛCDM limit, shift inferred spatial curvature in exponential quintessence, and can curvature improve the observational viability of steep potentials?

sources.title: Beta function quintessence cosmological parameters and fundamental constants – II. Exponential and logarithmic dark energy potentials

evidence.text: Do the finite scalar and potential changes of the evaluated quintessence models satisfy the conjectural swampland tests used in this paper?

sources.title: Quintessential interpretation of the evolving dark energy in light of DESI observations

evidence.text: Can canonical quintessence interpret the DESI 2024 preference for evolving dark energy despite the past phantom behavior of its linear parameterization, and what would this imply for Swampland conjectures, cosmic birefringence, and cosmic evolution?

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: Earlier constructions try to keep quintessence light through symmetry protection and weak matter couplings. The comparison asks whether those protections can coexist with the swampland slope and excursion requirements used in this paper.

sources.title: DESI results: hint towards coupled dark matter and dark energy

evidence.text: Can dark matter coupled to canonical quintessence produce an inferred dark-energy equation of state that crosses from below −1 in the past to above −1 today, while the scalar itself remains non-phantom and accommodates the DESI reconstruction?

sources.title: Dark Energy and the Refined de Sitter Conjecture

evidence.text: Does the refined de Sitter conjecture retain observable quintessence predictions when a negative Hessian eigenvalue can replace a potential-gradient bound? The paper examines equation-of-state limits, additional scalar sectors, and the conditions under which initial-state tuning hides a departure from a cosmological constant.

sources.title: Quantum gravity meets DESI: dynamical dark energy in light of the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Which dynamical dark-energy parameterizations and selected modified-gravity models can satisfy both DESI DR2-motivated quintom-B evolution and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture (TCC), including constraints on their future evolution?

sources.title: Reconstructing Quintessence

evidence.text: Can more direct expansion measurements break the oscillation degeneracy, and can a theory-specific EFT reconstruction test related restrictions beyond canonical quintessence?

sources.title: Anisotropic constant-roll inflationary scenario with complex quintessence field and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can complex quintessence subject to the paper's anisotropic constant-roll prescription yield exact background solutions whose potentials admit ranges compatible with the refined swampland conjecture?

sources.title: Reconstruction of quintessence field for the THDE with swampland correspondence in $f(R,T)$ gravity

evidence.text: Can Hubble-horizon Tsallis holographic dark energy (THDE) be represented by a canonical quintessence field in f(R,T) gravity, with reconstructed dynamics and potential, and related to the stated swampland criteria?

sources.title: Reconstructing Quintessence

evidence.text: Canonical quintessence replaces a constant dark-energy density with a minimally coupled scalar whose kinetic and potential energies determine cosmic expansion. A potential alone does not determine the history; scalar boundary conditions are also needed.

sources.title: Examining quintessence models with DESI data

evidence.text: Can NEC-preserving quintessence explain the initial DESI preference for evolving dark energy, and does an appropriate mapping to CPL parameters sustain earlier claims of an excellent hilltop fit?

sources.title: Multifield quintessential inflation and Swampland constraints in the IDM

evidence.text: Can an exponentially coupled quintessence–IDM framework support observationally viable inflation and effective late-time acceleration, and do its curved field space and multifield dynamics alleviate the refined de Sitter Swampland tension?

sources.title: Dark energy, extra dimensions, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can observationally allowed exponential quintessence be embedded in the NEC-preserving CRF compactifications examined by the paper?

sources.title: Cosmic Microwave Background Observables of Small Field Models of Inflation

evidence.text: Can effective single-field inflation produce detectable tensors and substantial negative scalar running with a Planck-scale or smaller excursion, and do EFT consistency conditions connect the running to the inflationary energy scale?

sources.title: Rapid-Turn Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: How can a heavy transverse field participate in inflation? Negative field-space curvature can destabilize ordinary slow roll and support a displaced turning trajectory in the imported minimal-geometry model.

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Can landscape inflation evade the small-tensor conclusion by using a different mechanism? The paper identifies successive vacuum tunnelling as an alternative outside its slow-roll field-budget calculation.

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: How does the canonical inflaton trajectory determine the inflationary expansion? The paper uses a spatially flat homogeneous background and counts e-folds backward from the end of inflation, with a monotonic field trajectory.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: Can the Standard Model Higgs drive inflation and generate acceptable primordial perturbations through a non-minimal gravitational coupling, without introducing an additional inflaton particle?

sources.title: Resonant Non-Gaussianity

evidence.text: Calculate the primordial scalar bispectrum for arbitrary momentum triangles in canonical single-field inflation with small periodic potential modulations, and determine its mechanism, shape and distinguishability from commonly searched templates.

sources.title: Statistical Anisotropy and the Vector Curvaton Paradigm

evidence.text: How can a massive vector spectator contribute to or generate the scalar curvature perturbation without excessive anisotropic stress, and which anisotropies in its spectrum and bispectrum distinguish vector-curvaton realizations?

sources.title: Constraints from Conformal Symmetry on the Three Point Scalar Correlator in Inflation

evidence.text: How strongly do approximate conformal symmetry and slow roll constrain the leading nonzero scalar bispectrum, its magnitude, and its determination from a soft limit of the scalar four-point function?

sources.title: Disentangling the $f(R)$ - Duality

evidence.text: How do decaying exponentials, rising exponentials, and monomial deformations of inflationary plateaus change their f(R) descriptions, including asymptotic powers, closed-form reconstructibility, and observable inflationary behavior?

sources.title: Gauss-Bonnet Inflation

evidence.text: Can a scalar coupled to the Gauss–Bonnet invariant generate early de Sitter expansion and an exit without an imposed scalar self-potential, after neglecting the Einstein–Hilbert term in a proposed strong-gravity regime?

sources.title: Initial conditions for inflation — A short review

evidence.text: How restrictive are initial conditions for scalar-field inflation, particularly after allowing matter and metric inhomogeneities, and why do assessments of inflation's likelihood differ?

sources.title: Positive curvature and scalar field tunneling in the landscape

evidence.text: Can semiclassical scalar-field tunneling from a spherical ancestor produce inflation with residual positive spatial curvature, preserving the ancestral geometry sufficiently to counter claims that positive curvature would falsify a landscape origin?

sources.title: A note on Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can observations exclude inflation through proposed field-range and potential-slope criteria without establishing the source of the final curvature perturbation or the numerical strength of the slope criterion?

sources.title: A note on Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: How do the potential slope and canonical field displacement relate to inflationary expansion? The baseline is a single canonical inflaton background, with kinetic slow-roll parameter εH and potential approximation εV.

sources.title: Warm DBI inflation with constant sound speed

evidence.text: Dissipation can maintain radiation during inflation and permit slow expansion on a steep potential. The paper assumes an equilibrated bath whose energy production changes slowly compared with dilution.

sources.title: Primordial Gravitational Waves and the Swampland

evidence.text: Determine whether quantum-gravity conjectures can restrict primordial tensor amplitudes without excluding canonical single-field slow-roll inflation with roughly 60 e-folds. The paper focuses on how uncertain conjecture parameters affect this compatibility.

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: Can the scalar responsible for steep-potential inflation become subdominant after inflation and later drive accelerated expansion?

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can radiation production during inflation remove the need for an oscillatory reheating minimum while permitting inflation on a potential restricted by the Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can single-field inflation satisfy conjectural quantum-gravity restrictions on its potential while reproducing a small tensor-to-scalar ratio and a nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum?

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: How does continuous energy transfer from an inflaton to radiation change inflation compared with an effectively isolated inflaton? The bath can remain populated during accelerated expansion while potential energy dominates.

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: Can dissipation complement brane corrections or modified kinetic terms that already permit steeper potentials? The paper presents this as an additional route beyond its canonical quartic examples.

sources.title: Phenomenological Consequences of the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a curvaton generate the observed scalar tilt while the inflaton satisfies a stronger curvature condition? The paper replaces the ordinary inflaton tilt relation with a horizon-exit curvaton expression.

sources.title: The Swampland Spectrum Conjecture in Inflation

evidence.text: How are multifield inflationary paths and their ordinary field excursions defined? Homogeneous fields evolve under a potential with Hubble friction on a curved, positive-definite target space.

sources.title: The Swampland Spectrum Conjecture in Inflation

evidence.text: Modular j-inflation supplies a curved two-field example for comparing a path in the upper half-plane with its lift to a potential surface. Its potential is modular invariant and its kinetic geometry is hyperbolic.

sources.title: Spinodal solution to swampland inflationary constraints

evidence.text: Does a potential-slope restriction exclude inflation when non-equilibrium fluctuations control the evolution? The authors propose assessing the relevant slope safety through the potential-driven stage.

sources.title: Hyperinflation generalised: from its attractor mechanism to its tension with the ‘swampland conditions’

evidence.text: Can a nonsymmetric model enter hyperinflation after an initially stable slow-roll phase? Here negative curvature destabilises the transverse direction as the quadratic potential becomes relatively steeper during descent.

sources.title: Hyperinflation generalised: from its attractor mechanism to its tension with the ‘swampland conditions’

evidence.text: Does a three-field evolution reproduce the analytic dependence on transverse speed? The reported numerical example follows the sum π_w1²+π_w2² rather than identifying either component with the two-field transverse velocity.

sources.title: Reheating After Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can interactions with light fields sustain inflation while transferring energy to radiation? The source represents this possibility through an enhanced friction term in the homogeneous inflaton equation.

sources.title: Rapid-Turn Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Does a common attractor describe sustained two-field inflation with strongly nongeodesic motion across different field-space geometries and potentials? The paper seeks a background construction and a conditional linear stability criterion.

sources.title: Rapid-Turn Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Can rapid turning occur without negative field-space curvature? The imported flat model combines radial stabilization with an angular slope and supplies such an example.

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Integrate the proposed trajectory, restrict its parameters, differentiate to reconstruct η and ξ, and evaluate the spectral formulas. Keep the trajectory family, endpoint prescription and slow-roll truncation explicit when comparing resulting bounds.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: The analysis uses Einstein-frame potential slow-roll parameters, the e-fold integral and the COBE normalization U/ε=(0.027MP)⁴. The authors state that the same inflationary results can be obtained in the Jordan frame.

sources.title: Cosmic Microwave Background Observables of Small Field Models of Inflation

evidence.text: Evaluate next-order slow-roll expressions, but numerically solve the full Mukhanov–Sasaki equation when treating slow-roll parameters as constant is inaccurate. Extract observables from the resulting scalar spectrum at a chosen pivot.

sources.title: Resonant Non-Gaussianity

evidence.text: Use leading-order in-in perturbation theory with the dominant interaction HI⊃−∫d³x a³εδ̇R²Ṙ. Unperturbed mode functions suffice at the retained order; the authors estimate derivative corrections during resonance to justify this approximation.

sources.title: Statistical Anisotropy and the Vector Curvaton Paradigm

evidence.text: The δN expansion expresses ζ in scalar and vector perturbations through second order. Polarization-resolved two-point functions and their tensor decomposition determine the power spectrum; the corresponding quadratic expansion supplies bispectra and f_NL.

sources.title: Constraints from Conformal Symmetry on the Three Point Scalar Correlator in Inflation

evidence.text: Treat Ward identities as linear inhomogeneous differential equations. Solve the homogeneous problem using eigenfunctions f_z(k)=(1+ikz)e^(−ikz), impose OPE limits, and give a formal integral prescription for the sourced solution.

sources.title: Perturbations in k-inflation

evidence.text: How do linear quantum cosmological perturbations generalize to a scalar Lagrangian p(X,ϕ), and what scalar and tensor spectra distinguish slow-roll or power-law k-inflation from potential-driven inflation?

sources.title: DBI N-flation

evidence.text: How do subleading large-N corrections change sound speed and equilateral non-Gaussianity in coincident-brane DBI inflation, and can transitions between matrix representations provide an alternative inflationary mechanism?

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent curvature coupling change inflationary observables enough to accommodate a steep potential and a small field excursion?
